items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 19 at 6:07PM AKST until November 19 at 8:00PM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow. Total snow accumulations between 5 and 10 inches.
Visibility as low as one half mile at times in heavy snow.

* WHERE...Turnagain Pass.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM AKST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. The hazardous conditions
will impact the Thursday evening commute.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snow continues to fall through Turnagain Pass
this afternoon. Snow may be heavy at times, with snowfall rates
between 1 and 2 inches per hour, through this evening before
ta
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 19 at 6:07PM AKST until November 19 at 8:00PM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 3 and 5
inches with locally higher amounts up to 8 inches possible along
the Anchorage and Eagle River Hillsides. Visibility reduced to as
low as one half mile at times in heavier snow. Snowfall rates of
1-2 inches per hour.

* WHERE...Anchorage / Eagle River (all elevations).

* WHEN...Until 8 PM AKST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. The hazardous conditions
will impact the Thursday evening commute.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 19 at 2:42PM AKST until November 20 at 9:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Annette Island, City and Borough of Wrangell, and Ketchikan
Gateway Borough.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make travel conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Slight improvements in visibility expected
through early evening hours, especially for Ketchikan and Annette
Island. Visibility is then expected to lower again later this
evening and overnight.
items.areas: City and Borough of Wrangell; Ketchikan Gateway Borough; Annette Island
items.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 19 at 2:39PM AKST until November 20 at 3:00AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels of 1 to 3 feet above the normal high tide
expected.

* WHERE...Kivalina and Red Dog Dock, Baldwin Peninsula and
Northern Seward Peninsula Coast.

* WHEN...From 9 PM this evening to 3 AM AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Localized beach erosion may occur.
items.areas: Kivalina and Red Dog Dock; Baldwin Peninsula; Northern Seward Peninsula
items.instruction: Precautions should be taken to protect property.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 19 at 1:31PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Moderate snow. Additional snowfall amounts of 3 to 6
inches with higher amounts up to around 8 to 14 inches along
the southern slopes of the Brooks Range.

* WHERE...Western Interior north into the Western Brooks Range.

* WHEN...Through Friday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult at times. Snow could reduce
visibility below one mile at times.
items.areas: South Slopes of the Western Brooks Range; Upper Kobuk Valleys; Lower Koyukuk Valley; Middle Yukon Valley

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 19 at 12:54PM AKST until November 21 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations of 5 to 10 inches.

* WHERE...Dalton Highway Summits, South Slopes Of The Central Brooks
Range, and Upper Koyukuk Valley.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The heaviest snowfall is expected along south
facing slopes, especially along the Brooks Range. Areas at lower
elevations, including along the Koyukuk River, are expected to see
lesser snow totals.
items.areas: South Slopes Of The Central Brooks Range; Upper Koyukuk Valley; Dalton Highway Summits
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 19 at 12:16PM AKST until November 21 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations of 4 to 8 inches.
Winds gusting as high as 35 mph.

* WHERE...Central Brooks Range, primarily Atigun Pass.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Near Atigun Pass periods of falling and
blowing snow could significantly reduce visibility to a half mile
or less at times. Snowfall will diminish Saturday morning.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.
